name: vehicle-mandatory-only
reference: Values chosen; encoded as the PDU type CAM of the ASN.1 module CAM-PDU-Descriptions (ETSI EN 302 637-2 v1.4.1, forge.etsi.org cam_en302637_2 commit fed28cfe5c930dd9d3109ff1162c28008697754a) with ITS-Container (TS 102 894-2 v1.3.1, commit 2d2450e79aab4c7032ef615b72ddefaf2e5ba8a9) by two independent UPER codecs that agree byte for byte: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper. A vehicle CAM (passengerCar, 48.2 N 11.5 E, heading 90.0 degrees, 5.00 m/s) with only the mandatory components: no OPTIONAL of CamParameters or of BasicVehicleContainerHighFrequency. 322 bits, padded to 41 octets. Checked against the pack's lines by a standalone reader and writer of them (Python standard library); derived without an engine.
